# s1nka — Kakhaber Sinauridze

> Kakhaber Sinauridze (s1nka) is a Product Designer specializing in UX/UI, product design, design systems, and native iOS applications — he designs, builds, and ships his own apps to the App Store.

## About

Product Designer combining strong visual design with user-centered thinking, shipping end-to-end: design, code, App Store release. Additional interests: programming, AI, and music production.

## Skills / Capabilities

- Design: takes a fuzzy idea from first sketch to a live App Store release (no hand-offs); design systems with tokens, components, and Figma libraries; interactive Figma prototypes that validate ideas before code
- Build: ships what he designs — four native iOS apps live on the App Store, built end-to-end in SwiftUI; React + TypeScript for web; AI-accelerated design→build→ship workflow
- Ship: automated CI/CD release pipelines (GitHub Actions, Fastlane); server-side AI proxies (Supabase Edge Functions) so no API keys ship in clients
- Beyond: music production, content automation

## Selected Projects (all designed, built, and shipped solo; all live on the App Store)

- Annoto (https://s1nka.com/projects/annoto | https://apps.apple.com/app/id6774044198): iOS screenshot annotation app with a Share Extension. SwiftUI + SwiftData. v1.0.2.
- MindWhisper AI (https://s1nka.com/projects/mindwhisper | https://apps.apple.com/app/id6755791263): voice-journaling app for mental wellbeing with AI-powered reflections. React Native (Expo) + Supabase Edge Functions. v1.1.3.
- Decision Engine AI (https://s1nka.com/projects/decision-engine-ai | https://apps.apple.com/app/id6760727264): native SwiftUI app for structured, AI-assisted decision making, with fully automated CI/CD. v1.0.5.
- Brain Snacks (https://s1nka.com/projects/brain-snacks | https://apps.apple.com/app/id6773241217): bite-size learning feed for iOS. SwiftUI. v1.0.6.
